title: A Debt for the Safehouse
author: Lena Ashgrove
blurb: Hazel Lockridge, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
